claims.statement: Public ledger, taxonomy, money views, the agent schema, and chat UI tables are created by timestamp-ordered SQL migrations; LangGraph checkpoint tables are created at chat startup by AsyncPostgresSaver.setup(), not by those migrations.

accounts is one row per unique IBAN. Import inserts it on the first statement, naming it from the bank and the last four IBAN characters, and the accounts API renames it and returns only those four characters.

Import writes one imports row per file and inserts transactions with ON CONFLICT (dedup_key) DO NOTHING. The key hashes the IBAN, booking date, amount, normalized description, printed balance, and occurrence within the file, so a re-upload adds no ledger rows.

At insert, tx_type follows the sign and category_source is none. Later categorization updates the same row. category_source user is a lock: the categorization update skips those rows, while pairing may still link a user-labelled own_accounts row without relabelling it.

description_raw can still hold a full card number, but import and the categorization backfill strip 12-19 digit words from merchant and bank_concept and keep only card_last4. The agent projections omit description_raw.

finance seed upserts categories and category_groups from categories.yaml and rules from rules.yaml, then disables any rule whose name is no longer in the file. It does not delete a category slug removed from YAML.
A categorize rule must have a category_slug and a refund rule must not, enforced by rules_kind_category_check. Enabled rules are what the cascade loads.

merchants is unique on name and match_key. category_slug and is_subscription are the default used by the cascade; cadence is an optional monthly, quarterly, or yearly override written by PATCH /merchants/{id}/cadence. A merge moves transactions and labels onto the surviving merchant and deletes the source.
transaction_labels is append-only classification history. Notes are not labels: set_note updates transactions.note and writes no history row. A note is at most 500 characters.

v_transactions_enriched is the only definition of spend and income: spend is the negated amount of expense rows, income is the amount of income rows, and transfers are zero in both. direction is the sign of amount, not the type. Dashboard totals and breakdowns query this view directly rather than the summary views.
v_monthly_summary and v_spend_by_category only aggregate v_transactions_enriched. No dashboard module queries them; tests/test_views.py locks their money-rule results.

v_subscriptions emits one row per merchant with flagged money-out expense charges. Cadence is merchants.cadence when set, otherwise the median gap (up to 60 days monthly, 61-200 quarterly, over 200 yearly; a single charge is monthly). monthly_equivalent divides the latest charge by 1, 3, or 12, and active is measured from the latest imported transaction, not today.

The agent schema views are thin projections of the public money views and omit ids, raw descriptions, IBANs, transfer_pair_id, and confidences. category and category_group coalesce null to the text uncategorized, which is distinct from the category slug uncategorized_expense.

agent_reader is a NOLOGIN role with USAGE on schema agent and SELECT on its views, granted to the migrating user with SET but not INHERIT. Every agent query sets the transaction read-only, switches to that role, sets search_path to agent, and applies a statement timeout. The role cannot read public base tables.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW preserves existing grants, so display names could append category_name and group_name without re-granting. Dropping and recreating agent.subscriptions required a fresh GRANT SELECT to agent_reader.

Chat startup validates the semantic YAML against the live agent views and EXPLAINs every metric and example as agent_reader. A column added or renamed in the views without a matching YAML edit fails startup.

chat_threads and chat_messages are the UI history and never shrink. The agent's memory is a separate LangGraph checkpoint store. Deleting a thread cascades its messages and then deletes the checkpoint thread; summarization rewrites checkpoints only.

Public tables have no row-level security. The schema is safe only as a single-user local database and must not be hosted or exposed through the Data API as-is. Architecture records that limit and points ideas and known bugs at GitHub issues rather than at a design file. Those issues are not tables, views, or roles. A linked issue is not a schema object.
balance_after is stored on transactions and included in the dedup fingerprint, but no money or agent view exposes it, because within-day movement order is not stored.
